topic: During the timeskip Rayleigh asked Luffy what he would do against someone who sees the future with Observation Haki, and years later Katakuri on Whole Cake Island was exactly that opponent
title: Rayleigh's Question Predicted Luffy vs Katakuri
description: Rayleigh asked Luffy one question about future sight Observation Haki during the timeskip. Years later, Charlotte Katakuri showed up with exactly that power. Was it a coincidence, or was Rayleigh planting a lesson Luffy would have to solve alone?
comment: Was Rayleigh's future sight question planned for Katakuri, or just a throwaway line? Pick a side.

lines.text: Rayleigh maybe asked Luffy one question only Katakuri could answer.

shot.fallback: old pirate asking a boy a question

lines.text: During the timeskip, Rayleigh teaches Observation Haki with a blindfold and a hundred dodges.
Then he adds a throwaway line: some people can see a glimpse of the future.

shot.fallback: figure seeing a glowing vision ahead

lines.text: He asks Luffy what he'd do if he ever faced one of them.
Years later, Charlotte Katakuri shows up with exactly that: Future Vision, a few seconds ahead.

shot.fallback: tall scarfed fighter seeing seconds ahead

lines.text: In chapter 878, Luffy drags him into the Mirro-World, and it's one on one.

shot.fallback: two fighters in a world of mirrors

lines.text: He does it to buy his friends time, so the fight is his alone.

shot.fallback: boy facing a tall fighter alone

lines.text: Here's my read: that wasn't trivia. Rayleigh planted a question Luffy could only answer under pressure.

shot.fallback: old teacher planting an idea in a student

lines.text: Rayleigh's rule says Haki grows against someone stronger, and chapter 886 confirms it.

shot.fallback: boy powering up against a stronger foe

lines.text: A teacher who sets up a lesson years early isn't improvising. He's planning.

shot.fallback: silver haired pirate with a serious stare

lines.text: So if he planned that far ahead, why would he walk away for the last six months?

shot.fallback: old man walking away from an island camp

lines.text: Because the real surprise is who set that trap years early:

shot.fallback: old pirate with a knowing smile

self_check.hook: A concrete question-and-payoff hook that names Rayleigh, Luffy and Katakuri in the first line.
self_check.loop: The last line sets up 'who set that trap' and flows straight back into line 1.
